        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          cache: npm
      - uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          cache: npm
      - uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v4
      - run: npm ci

      - run: npx nx affected:test --ci --code-coverage

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:

      - uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v4
